COALESCE(sum(ast07_for_amt), 0) AS accrued_amt FROM ast07_settle WHERE ast07_tr_id = ast06_tr_id ) acc LEFT OUTER JOIN ast01_class_tree a ON a.ast01_class_tree_id = ast06_ast_class_tree_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ast01_class_tree b ON b.ast01_class_tree_id = ast06_deposit_id LEFT OUTER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = ast06_corp_id LEFT OUTER JOIN act02_journal ON act02_tr_id = ast06_tr_id WHERE ast06_company_id = #{companyId} AND accrued_amt != 0 AND COALESCE(a.ast01_asset_type,'1') = #{assetType} AND COALESCE(ast06_settle_mng_yn,'false') = 'true' AND 'Y' = CASE WHEN COALESCE(( SELECT count(*) FROM act03_journal_dtl INNER JOIN act13_real_account_map ON ( act13_company_id = act02_company_id AND act13_real_account_cd IN (act03_dr_account_cd, act03_cr_account_cd) ) WHERE act03_journal_id = act02_journal_id AND substr(act13_repr_account_cd,1,2) IN ('12','22') ),0) = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AND ast05_rcv_pay_cd like #{payCode} AND /* 반제거래는 원본거래랑 세트로 제외 (9911:펀드운용보수 미수반제처리 / 9921:펀드사무관리보수 미수반제처리) */ ast06_tr_id NOT IN ( SELECT ast06_org_tr_id FROM ast06_tr WHERE ast06_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast06_tr_cd IN ('9911','9921') ) AND ast06_tr_cd NOT IN ('9911','9921') /* (2025.06.20 CYY - 지출결의서 존재시 미수/미지급 정리(미지급반제)는 거래내역(ast06)이 아닌 지출결의서내역(pay50)으로 정리함) */ AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pay50_expense WHERE pay50_expense_id = ast06_expense_id) AND ( ( '1' = #{abroType} AND /* 1:국내 */ COALESCE(ast06_cur_cd,'KRW') = 'KRW' ) OR ( '2' = #{abroType} AND /* 2:국외 */ COALESCE(ast06_cur_cd,'KRW') != 'KRW' ) ) AND ( ( #{userId} IN ( SELECT ast06_person_id UNION ALL SELECT ast10_person_id FROM ast10_manager WHERE ast10_manager_type = '1' AND ast10_link_id IN (ast06_tr_id,ast06_ast_class_tree_id) ) ) OR ( #{orgId} IN ( SELECT ast10_org_id FROM ast10_manager WHERE ast10_manager_type = '2' AND ast10_link_id IN (ast06_tr_id,ast06_ast_class_tree_id) UNION ALL SELECT CAST(f_get_empTrans(ast06_person_id, to_date(substr(ast06_tr_id||'',1,8),'yyyymmdd'), 'org_code_id') AS NUMERIC) ) ) ) UNION ALL SELECT pay50_expense_id as ast06_tr_id , pay50_company_id as ast06_company_id , pay50_occ_date as ast06_date , '9100' as ast06_tr_cd /*(9100:사업비 발생)*/ , pay50_settle_amt as ast06_amt , pay50_settle_amt as ast06_for_amt , pay50_desc as ast06_note , null as ast06_class_tree_nm , null as ast06_class_tree_full_nm , f_cdnm('trCode', '9100', pay50_company_id, pay50_occ_date) as ast06_tr_nm , '02' as ast06_rcv_pay_cd /*(01:수령/02:지급)*/ , accrued_amt as ast06_accrued_amt , pay50_corp_id as ast06_corp_id , f_get_corp_nm(pay50_corp_id) as ast06_corp_nm , pay50_deposit_id as ast06_deposit_id , ast01_class_tree_nm as ast06_deposit_name , pay50_desc as ast06_input_note , null as note , null as ast_class_tree_id FROM pay50_expense INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON ( apr01_appr_id = pay50_settle_appr_id AND apr01_status_cd = '30' ) INNER JOIN ast01_class_tree ON ast01_class_tree_id = pay50_deposit_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT pay50_settle_amt - COALESCE(sum(ast07_amt), 0) AS accrued_amt FROM ast07_settle WHERE ast07_expense_id = pay50_expense_id ) acc WHERE pay50_company_id = #{companyId} AND accrued_amt != 0 AND '02' like #{payCode} AND '1' = #{abroType} /*(1:국내/2:해외) */ AND 'Y' = CASE WHEN pay50_expense_cd = '50' THEN 'Y' /*(50:법인카드)*/ ELSE (CASE WHEN COALESCE(( SELECT count(*) FROM act03_journal_dtl INNER JOIN act13_real_account_map ON ( act13_company_id = pay50_company_id AND act13_real_account_cd IN (act03_dr_account_cd, act03_cr_account_cd) ) WHERE act03_journal_id IN ( SELECT pay50_journal_id UNION ALL SELECT act02_journal_id FROM act02_journal INNER JOIN ast06_tr ON ast06_tr_id = act02_tr_id WHERE ast06_expense_id = pay50_expense_id ) AND substr(act13_repr_account_cd,1,2) IN ('12','22') ),0) = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END) END ) t WHERE 1=1 AND ast06_tr_cd LIKE #{trCode} AND ast06_corp_id = #{corpId} AND CONCAT(ast06_tr_nm, ast06_corp_nm, ast06_class_tree_nm, ast06_note, note) ILIKE '%'||#{searchText}||'%' ORDER BY ast06_date, ast06_tr_id
